summary: Ubuntu 14.04 (Trusty Tahr) was the fifth LTS release. Standard support ended 25 April 2019; ESM available until 2024-04-25 for paid Ubuntu Pro subscribers. Features: improved Unity, better HiDPI support, LXD container manager introduced, LibreOffice 4.2, kernel 3.13. Widely used for servers and desktops. The tahr (Himalayan tahr, a mountain goat) symbolized stability and sure-footedness.
notes: Standard support ended 2019-04-25. ESM until 2024-04-25 for Ubuntu Pro. Kernel 3.13. Trusty remains popular on older hardware and in container base images.
